commit_message: Make Bloom spread regression robust to final-pixel quantization
pr_title: Renderer: verify Bloom affects final pixels on current main
pr_body:
## Summary

Keeps the Bloom GPU readback regression coverage test-only and makes the spread assertion observable after final Rgba8 tone-map quantization. Production renderer behavior is unchanged.

The first exact-head validation proved the final-pixel toggle test passes on Windows GPU, while the spread test produced zero byte-level delta outside the source footprint at intensity 4. This correction raises only the test Bloom intensity so any real reconstructed halo survives final-pixel quantization; a renderer with no spatial spread still produces zero outside-footprint delta.

Visual Validation is N/A.

## Validation

Run exact-head affected Windows Validation for `engine-render-runtime` and use only the result for this PR head.
